snippet.title: Asteroid Requiem - Developer Walkthrough
snippet.description:
What if a rock could remember? What if a stone could long for home?
This is a quiet walkthrough of Asteroid Requiem, a short and reflective game about memory, orbit, and the ruins we leave behind.
I made this as a solo developer, from code to soundtrack to story. It’s part arcade, part narrative poem, and a little love letter to Earth.
In this video, I share the core mechanics, themes, and emotional intent behind the game.

If you're into slow sci-fi, gentle destruction, or games that make you feel something… I’d be honoured if you gave it a look.
